---
title: "RSS"
---

Three feeds. Each carries the whole text of a post, not a summary.

| Feed | Address |
|---|---|
| Everything | `https://psychometrician.github.io/index.xml` |
| R posts only | `https://psychometrician.github.io/index-rstats.xml` |
| Julia posts only | `https://psychometrician.github.io/index-julialang.xml` |

Subscribe to the first one if you want everything. The other two are for
[R-bloggers](https://www.r-bloggers.com/) and
[JuliaBloggers](https://www.juliabloggers.com/), which republish one language
each, so a feed of everything would send them posts their readers did not ask
for.

There is no Python or JavaScript feed, and the reason is about how those
communities work rather than about the languages. R and Julia have sites that
subscribe to a feed and republish from it. Python and JavaScript do not: their
newsletters take one submission at a time, by form or by mail, so a feed there
would have nobody at the other end.

Only the first address is announced in the page header, which is what a reader's
feed reader finds on its own. The other two are here because nothing else on the
site links them.
